description: ab_testing/evaluation.py labels simple role/empty-message checks as semantic parity / '100% Structural Equivalence', openbrain_memory.py leaves sqlite3 connections unclosed, and rag_indexer.py includes an internal control-plane directory name missed by tests/test_repo_hygiene.py.
goal: In src/holon_coherence/ab_testing/evaluation.py (keeping it at most 644 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json), rename _check_semantic_parity to _check_structural_parity and replace '100% Structural Equivalence' phrasing with accurate structural-check wording (updating assertions in tests/test_ab_testing.py and tests/test_ab_testing_domain.py cleanly). In src/holon_coherence/openbrain_memory.py (at most 200 lines), wrap every sqlite3.connect call in contextlib.closing so connections always close on exit. In src/holon_coherence/rag_indexer.py (at most 200 lines), remove the hidden task-tracking directory literal from ignored directories, and update tests/test_repo_hygiene.py to reject bare occurrences of that hidden directory token as well as slash-suffixed forms (constructing test patterns from short string fragments so no literal match appears in the test file). Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Accurate function names prevent overstating test verification claims, closed SQLite handles stop resource leaks, and tightened hygiene regexes keep control-plane path tokens out of target repositories.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/ab_testing/evaluation.py defines _check_structural_parity without _check_semantic_parity, updates tests/test_ab_testing.py and tests/test_ab_testing_domain.py cleanly, and stays at most 644 lines.
src/holon_coherence/openbrain_memory.py closes all sqlite3 connections cleanly with contextlib.closing and stays at most 200 lines.

src/holon_coherence/rag_indexer.py removes the hidden task-tracking directory literal, tests/test_repo_hygiene.py fails on bare occurrences constructed dynamically from fragments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass with zero docstrings/comments and without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
